title: piher role manifest (D76 v2)
description: Tier-2 role manifest contract: version (P2 semantic version) + roleType (P3 planner/executor/hybrid) + rules (P1 allow/deny). Runtime validation is the hand-written zero-dependency implementation in src/role-manifest.ts; this file is the contract document.

role.description: Role name; must match the file name

model.description: Per-role model routing, provider/model (WS-D10; optional = process default)

thinking.description: Thinking level for the child launch; the spawn emits --thinking. Consumed only when the master builds argv, never carried in the worker's runtime env. Optional = process default

lifecycle.description: Added by P7. Lifetime of a worker of this role: persistent (default) settles and stays available for send; one-shot pushes its settlement notice and exits, so the pane goes without waiting for the GC TTL. Per role, never per spawn

instructions.description: Prose too long for a bullet: injected after guidelines in the same piher-role prompt section. There is no second prompt channel

modelInvocable.description: false keeps the role launchable by name but out of the master's role catalog (internal or experimental roles). Absent = true

guidelines.description: P0 per-role behavior constraints (RFC §4.6): constraints on "how to use" tools that the tool set cannot express, injected each turn as the piher-role prompt section; omit instead of passing an empty array

tools.description: Baseline tools; the role declares exactly what it wants (no coordination floor)

rules.description: Permissions; * is the wildcard default; optional = {"*":"allow"}

unknownTools.description: D82 unknown-tool stance (default deny): allow = user-installed extensions are visible and usable by default (master/worker); deny = anything outside the list is invisible. Orthogonal to the rules * wildcard (visibility vs enforcement)
